verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS tax platform with official API client libraries, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The cited material covers only API usage, integrations, AutoFile and pricing.
